frametime.sentence: Pixelforge announced the Forge Deck 2 on Saturday, the successor to its handheld game console.
The new model has an 8-inch screen.
Pixelforge claims it delivers 2.5 times the graphics performance of the original Forge Deck.

byteward.sentence: Pixelforge on Saturday announced the Forge Deck 2, a new version of its handheld game console.
The base model comes with 512 GB of storage.
Pixelforge is also cutting the price of the original Forge Deck to $349.

launch-desk.sentence: Pixelforge has announced the Forge Deck 2 handheld console.
A model with 1 TB of storage costs $649.
The original Forge Deck drops to $349.
Pixelforge says it has sold 6.2 million of them.

ohm-and-bit.sentence: Pixelforge has unveiled the Forge Deck 2, the second generation of its handheld console.
Behind it sits a 60 Wh battery.
All that battery brings the weight to 690 g.
Pixelforge lets the chip draw up to 18 W in games.
The battery is held in with screws rather than glue.

bench-and-bill.sentence: Pixelforge announced the Forge Deck 2, its next handheld console, on Saturday.
Under the Parts and Manuals Act, handheld consoles must carry a repairability score starting July 1, 2027.
The Forge Deck 2 goes on sale February 18.
Pixelforge says it will print the label on the box from day one anyway.
The company gives the console a repairability score of 8 out of 10.
Its battery is fastened with screws, not glue.
